name: Failure Reconstructed — premium forensic motion style
concept: Forensic engineering on a dark blueprint field: the failed object drawn as clean line work, the failure chain lit link by link, dates and counts as evidence stamps. Steel blue marks what held, rust-orange the step that gave way, red only the failure itself.
distinctFrom: ImpossibleBrief (deep-space blue, luminous bodies) and The Hidden Logic of Things (warm desk, printed matter): no starfield, no paper desk.
rules: Every scene states a visualPurpose that narration alone cannot deliver.
Every scene cites evidence fact ids; on-screen numbers must appear in a cited fact.
Drawn objects whose real geometry is not in the evidence are marked conceptual and show the CONCEPTUAL chip.
No two consecutive scenes use the same transition; at most one plain dissolve per Short.
Text on screen never duplicates the caption at the same moment: a headline or quote card switches captions off for its words.
Essential text >= 30 px at 1080 width, >= 32 px from the frame edge, outside the caption band and the bottom UI zone.
Every scene shows the evidence layer of what it says: KNOWN SCIENCE, ESTIMATE or SPECULATIVE (from the narration line layer).
Scale drawings that are not computed from cited numbers carry the ILLUSTRATION chip.
